session.name: Build Through Pressure
objectives: Create passing options around the player in possession.
Recognise when to play through pressure and when to switch.
Support the next pass with purposeful movement.

activities.name: Dynamic Passing Activation
instructions: Players pass in pairs and move into a new space after each pass.
Add dynamic mobility between passing actions.
coachingPoints: Use the first touch to prepare the next pass.
progressions: Receive on the back foot and change direction.
regressions: Reduce movement speed and allow extra touches.

activities.name: 5v2 Rondo
instructions: Run two groups of five attackers against two defenders.
Keep possession and move to offer a new passing angle.
coachingPoints: Communicate before the receiver is under pressure.
variations: Award a point for a split pass.

activities.name: Positional Possession
instructions: Organise six against six with two neutral players.
Use the neutral players to maintain possession.
Switch the ball when the central route is blocked.
coachingPoints: Recognise the free player before receiving.
progressions: Require a switch before scoring a possession point.
regressions: Allow the neutral players unlimited touches.
variations: Change the positions of the neutral players.

activities.name: Build-Out Conditioned Game
instructions: Play seven against seven towards two small goals at each end.
Restart from the defending end after every goal.
Reward controlled progression through the middle third.
coachingPoints: Create a passing option on both sides of the ball.
progressions: Apply a time limit to progress out of the defensive third.
regressions: Allow an unopposed first pass from restarts.
variations: Award an additional point for switching before scoring.

activities.name: Mobility & Reflection
instructions: Reduce intensity with walking and gentle mobility.
Ask players to describe one way they created a passing option.
